column1: # Well-known people's names and their Hanja. People: Wikidata (CC0), humans of a Korean or Chinese state with at least
# 6 sitelinks and an article on Korean Wikipedia, queried 2026-11-06. Hanja: the opening section of that article
# (CC BY-SA 4.0), kept only when every character's sound matches the name's Hangul. A wiki is a secondary source.
# Rows sharing a reading are ordered by sitelinks. The note gives the Wikidata item and the article's revision.
